First alpha of Media Manager. Install it with BRAT.

**Gallery layout for Bases**

- Photos, videos and PDFs from a note property, laid out as a mosaic or as justified rows.
- Tile size can follow how related a note is, or a property you choose.
- Only on-screen tiles exist, and sizes and thumbnails are cached on your device, so large vaults scroll smoothly.

**Viewing**

- Click to fill the window, MUBI style. Scroll, click outside or press Esc to close.
- Videos preview on hover, and play zoomed with their own controls and keys.
- PDFs open in Obsidian's own PDF viewer.
- The **i** button shows the note's properties, and a map when the note has a location and Obsidian Maps is installed.
- Cmd-← and Cmd-→ step through items while zoomed.

**Images in notes**

- Images in notes open with the same zoom. Turn this off in **Settings → Media Manager**.

**Known limits**

- Not tested on mobile.
- HEIC photos and Dolby Atmos audio don't play in Obsidian.
